title: A generalization of moderated statistics to data adaptive semiparametric estimation in high-dimensional biology
authors: Hejazi, Boileau, van der Laan, Hubbard
one_line_what_it_does: Applies limma empirical-Bayes variance shrinkage (s2_tilde=(d_b s_b^2+d_0 s_0^2)/(d_b+d_0)) to the influence-curve variance of asymptotically linear (TMLE) estimators across many biomarkers; says extension to clustered units needs only minor modification; advocates a logistic reference distribution instead of t on d_0+d_b df
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Core mechanism: moderated-t on influence-function variances of a semiparametric estimator across many outcomes with few samples. PPI estimators are asymptotically linear, so this is the same recipe; PPI instance not done

title: Prediction-Powered Adaptive Shrinkage Estimation (PAS)
one_line_what_it_does: Empirical-Bayes (SURE-tuned) shrinkage across m PPI problems toward the predictions; per-problem power tuning lambda_j; variances sigma_j treated as plug-in inputs; paper states average-coverage CIs are future work (cites Armstrong-Kolesar-Plagborg-Moller)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: EB across many PPI tasks (means, not variances); no variance moderation, no df augmentation, no cluster setting; lambda_j computed per problem in Algorithm 1 (I found no cross-task shrinkage of lambda_j itself)

title: Empirical Bayes prepivoting under group invariance: FDR control and moderated t-tests
one_line_what_it_does: Moderated-t procedures with finite-sample FDR control under independence across units and null group invariance (sign flips/rotations), without limma hierarchical model; matches oracle lfdr power under limma working model
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: FDR part of claim and robustness of moderation to violated scaled-inv-chi2 model; not PPI, but a sign-flip version on cluster-level rectifier contributions is the obvious route

title: Linear models and empirical Bayes methods for assessing differential expression in microarray experiments (limma)
venue_or_arxiv: Stat Appl Genet Mol Biol 3(1); PMID 16646809
one_line_what_it_does: Hierarchical model on gene variances; moderated t with d_0+d_g df; exact under normal / scaled-inverse-chi2 model
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Defines the moderated t and its exactness under the normal model

title: Prediction-Powered Inference Across Many Tasks for AI Evaluation & Social Science Research
one_line_what_it_does: Multi-task PPI with cross-task recalibration (GRePPI, ARePPI) while keeping task-specific rectification and studentized Wald intervals; scarce labels per task; no variance moderation, no limma
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Multi-outcome PPI with few labels: borrows the proxy-label map, not the rectifier variance; says combining with PAS-style EB is future work

title: Empirical Bayes Rebiasing
one_line_what_it_does: Learns the bias distribution across many tasks (incl. PPI, family GWAS) and re-introduces bias to shorten calibrated intervals; assumes variances estimated accurately (e.g., bootstrap)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: EB across many PPI tasks aimed at calibrated intervals, but pools the bias not the variance; no few-cluster df issue

title: Cluster-Robust Prediction-Powered Inference
one_line_what_it_does: Cluster-robust SEs for PPI++ with fully/partially labeled clusters; cluster-aware power tuning; asymptotic
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Per-gene cluster-level variance estimator that would be moderated; asymptotic, no small-G correction or multi-outcome pooling in abstract

title: Synthetic-Powered Multiple Testing with FDR Control (SynthBH)
one_line_what_it_does: BH-type multiple testing with guarded p-values using synthetic data; FDR control
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: FDR across genes with synthetic/predicted data; no variance moderation

bears_on_which_part_of_claim: PPI in genomics with many parallel tests; per-SNP variances not moderated (as far as abstract/snippets show)
